text: Instead of paying for tutors, you pay with your own knowledge. Enter the skills you can teach and the skills you want to learn. The Swap Matrix instantly finds overlaps in the network, proposing 1-on-1 swaps that benefit both parties equally.

text: Learning in isolation leads to knowledge gaps. Foster provides community-curated skill trees. Select a destination (e.g., "Full Stack Web3 Developer") and the platform breaks it down into swappable milestones you can achieve with peers.

text: Join the thousands already swapping skills on Foster.
